items.prompt: Why is most_common alone insufficient for ties?

options.why: Counter retains positive counts; losing them is not the tie-order issue.
most_common can return multiple entries; its equal-count order is the mismatch.
Equal-count values are not automatically ordered numerically descending by most_common.
Equal counts follow first-encounter order, while this task requires the smaller numeric value first.

items.explanation: The source instead requires smaller numeric value first.
